subject: chemistry
content: A plant virus is found to consist of uniform cylindrical particles of 150 Å in diameter and 5000 Å long. The specific volume of the virus is 0.75 cm<sup>3</sup>/g. If the virus is considered to be a single particle, find its molar mass.
